• "Insolent" means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect. Its closest synonym is "Disrespectful". (बदतमीज़ / अभद्र)

◦ Correct: The teacher reprimanded the student for his insolent (disrespectful) remarks during the morning assembly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Dull" (lacking in vitality, energy, or brilliance; unimpressive), Option 3 "Mild" (having a mild, kind, or tender temperament or manner) and Option 4 "Chew" (to eat something steadily and often noisily) are unrelated to the meaning of "insolent".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of insolent: disrespectful. Antonyms: respectful, polite, courteous.
